notes.title: Refunct Update 10
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/aZcGfuC.jpg

Hey all! Refunct Update 10 is now live which improves movement, optimization and more:
Added mid-air step-up mechanic making movement smoother by adding leeway when barely missing edges on landing
Added 10-40% resolution scale for extremely low-end systems
Improved climbing at steep angles
Improved collision consistency by always using flat movement base
Improved performance using LODs, model and render tweaks
Fixed jerky physics while moving on rising islands
Fixed camera dipping into water in rare cases
Increased minimum required climb height slightly
Tweaked button collision by tapering off the top to fix sliding in rare cases with the collision changes


This update has been iterated on with the critical and passionate speedrun community. Also you can now name your price and pay what you want for Refunct's soundtrack / OST by Kristofferson getting it in high-quality MP3, FLAC and more.

Finally Refunct was released two years ago and I really just wanted to thank you all for your support.

Take care!

notes.title: Refunct Update 9
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/jOoiTKY.jpg

Hey guys! Refunct Update 9 is now live which adds better water reflections, 6 new achievements, 11 new languages and more:Added lit and shadowed real-time planar water reflections on at least medium and especially ultra effects quality settings (not supported on Linux)
Added 6 achievements
Added Arabic (not supported on Linux), Bulgarian, Czech, European Portuguese, Greek, Hungarian, Japanese, Romanian, Thai, Traditional Chinese and Ukrainian localization
Added right-to-left UI layout support for Arabic
Improved some existing localizations
Improved outro text quality
Fixed maintaining velocity when walljumping off of the very top of objects
Fixed resetting language to default on macOS and Linux
Tweaked automatically detected quality settings
Tweaked alternate outro text criteria
Tweaked selecting first played music on startup
Achievements
Of the new achievements there are 3 which add additional questions asked from the collected cubes which will be automatically awarded if you start Refunct on a completed save.

The other 3 achievements are about finishing Refunct under a certain completion% and in specific times adding challenge while still being very fair for those wanting to experience the depth of the movement system and introducing different ways to play Refunct. They were added due to high demand for replayability after getting 100% Refunct in-game and to make sure that Refunct has the same features on Steam compared to the recently released Xbox One version.

I am sorry for those that might feel temporarily robbed of one of their "Perfect Games" due to adding those achievements post-release so if you are not able to complete them please feel free to send me a mail to the address found on the support page so I can unlock them for you.

Speedrun
Also consider joining the Refunct speedrun community and challenge yourself further by submitting your recorded runs to the official leaderboard where you can see some cool tricks and optimal routes which may be helpful for getting the achievements.

Conclusion
Hopefully adding those completely optional achievements and other improvements like better reflections adds more value to you guys. Additionally Refunct is now available in all 27 languages currently supported by Steam thanks to the translations done by this awesome community.

Your continued support and understanding is very appreciated. Take care!

Hi! Refunct Update 8 has been released which aims to reduce causing motion sickness for people prone to it and incorporates various player feedback:

Improved camera smoothness by using flat movement base collision on the ground
Fixed a few localization strings
Fixed showing incorrect restart message in rare cases
Fixed executable icon after Update 7
Tweaked hiding restart message after first instead of second restart after game completion
Tweaked default quality scaling
Reverted island rise timing changes of Update 7


Additionally if you are very prone to motion sickness the following may help further:

Try to not think about motion sickness
Reduce mouse/gamepad sensitivity
Tweak the graphics settings to run Refunct with at least 60 fps
Tweak the field of view
Set anti-aliasing to low or none
Do not hide the reticle

notes.title: Refunct Update 4
notes.notes:
Due to popular demand a new update has been released to improve the speedrunning experience including a completion timer, instant restarts and more!

Speedrun
Head over to speedrun.com/Refunct to take part in the speedrun community. Simply record a video of your run, press the menu button during Refunct's outro to show the completion time (after completing the game at least once), upload it to Youtube or similar and submit it.

Livesplit
Advanced Windows users can use Livesplit to get a timer overlay with splits on each button press. Simply download Livesplit, extract it, start Livesplit executable, right-click opened window, choose Open Splits > From URL, paste http://refunctgame.com/splits and click OK, right-click window again, choose Edit Splits and press Activate, then start Refunct, go to ESC > Options > Window Mode > Switch to Windowed Fullscreen and start running. You only manually need to reset Livesplit after a completed run using a hotkey as defined in Livesplit settings.

Discord
You can also join the community moderated Refunct speedrun Discord server to chat with the runners and get help setting up Livesplit.

Changelog

Added game completion timer shown in menu during outro after completing game once
Added instant game restart
Added persistent music and time of day through restarts
Added underwater low-pass music filter
Added exit game confirmation dialog
Added focusing restart button on menu and hiding level restart confirmation after second restart
Tweaked memory layout for better compatibility with external speedrun tools
Removed loading screen
